name: Spotify Like
author: freezombie
description: A heart in the bar that shows whether the playing Spotify track is in Liked Songs and adds it on click. Works on Free accounts through a small Spicetify extension; no Web API, no login.

barWidget.description: Heart for the playing Spotify track: left-click adds it to Liked Songs, right-click removes it.

schema.label: Place next to the media widget
schema.description: after = right of it (below on a vertical bar), before = left of it (above), manual = stay where you put it. The heart follows when you switch or move your media widget, not when you drag the heart. setup/install asks for this.

schema.label: Hide the heart
schema.description: auto = like your media widget; never = whenever a song is loaded; stopped = while Spotify is stopped (after it opens, until you press play); paused = whenever Spotify is not playing.

schema.label: Media widget id
schema.description: Widget id to follow when yours is not recognised automatically, e.g. a clone such as yourname.media.
